notes.title: [Announcement] Block the Monster at GXG 2025!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Adventurers![/p][p]Block the Monster is coming offline to meet gamers in person![/p][p]
[/p][p]🎮 Event: GXG 2025 x INDIECRAFT[/p][p]📍 Location: Pangyo Station Square & Pangyo Tech One Tower[/p][p]📅 Date: September 19 (Fri) – 20 (Sat), 2025[/p][p]
[/p][p]Come and play Block the Monster on-site and chat freely with our dev team.[/p][p]We’ve also prepared special events and gifts for visitors, so don’t miss it![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you for your support, and see you in Pangyo![/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707362/8f51ec0445cf25b7869aedc4cdd8ec4150141e21.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [Patch Note] New Update & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is the Block the Monster development team.[/p][p]We would like to sincerely thank all of you for playing and supporting Block the Monster.[/p][p]Even after the official release, we are continuously working on updates and improvements to deliver a better gameplay experience.[/p][p]
[/p][p]This update includes several hotfixes and improvements for a smoother and more stable environment.[/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Update Details][/p][p]Added and revised certain character dialogue texts[/p][p]Fixed specific bugs occurring when deleting towers[/p][p]Improved parts of the in-game UI[/p][p]Overall performance optimization and stability enhancements[/p][p]
[/p][p]We will continue to resolve issues as quickly as possible and actively reflect your valuable feedback to further enhance the quality of the game.[/p][p]Your continued support and feedback mean a lot to us.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Block the Monster Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Game will Publish Soon!
notes.content:
Now the Game is One the Reviewing stage!

I can't wait to show my game to you guys! Thank you for Waiting my game!

The game will publish in two weeks.

Thank you!
